title: Premium Advancements | Custom Achievements
description: Create unlimited custom advancements/achievements with a clean editor or GUI. Vault • +45 Triggers • MySQL • MiniMessage & Hex colors • Webhooks • 1.21+ Support
body:
**Premium Advancements** Create unlimited custom advancements with an in-game & web GUI editor. No config files needed.

[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21+-brightgreen)](https://papermc.io)
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange)](https://adoptium.net)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-2.1-blue)]()

---

## Why Premium Advancements?

The easiest way to add achievements, quests, and progression to your Minecraft server. **45 triggers**, real-time
tracking, **8 reward types**, **multi-tab system**, **Discord webhooks**, and both an in-game and **browser-based web
editor** with live tree view - all without editing a single configuration file.

---

## Features

- **MiniMessage & Hex Colors** - `&#RRGGBB`, gradients, rainbows, bold/italic/underline, named colors (`<light_purple>`)
  supported everywhere — in-game L menu, GUIs, broadcasts, and the web editor live preview
- **Multi-Tab System** - Organize advancements across multiple tabs, each with its own icon, background, and namespace
- **Vanilla Advancement Viewer** - Minecraft's built-in advancements (Story, Adventure, Nether, End, Husbandry) loaded
  read-only with correct icons, positions, and tree connections
- **In-Game GUI Editor** - 6 screens: main list, tab selector, create wizard, edit, confirm delete, stats viewer
- **Web Editor (Browser-Based)** - Full visual editor with live tree view, drag & drop, undo/redo, import/export JSON,
  icon browser, tab management
- **45 Trigger Types** - JOIN, BREAK_BLOCK, PLACE_BLOCK, KILL, OBTAIN_ITEM, CRAFT_ITEM, SMELT_ITEM, ANVIL_USE,
  GRINDSTONE_USE, ENCHANT_ITEM, ENCHANT, ENTER_DIMENSION, TRAVEL_DISTANCE, FISH, BREED, TAME, CONSUME, EAT, HARVEST,
  TRADE, POTION_EFFECT, DEATH, DAMAGE_DEALT, DAMAGE_TAKEN, JUMP, DROP_ITEM, SHEAR, MILK, COMPOSTER_USE, ARMOR_EQUIP,
  FILL_BUCKET, EMPTY_BUCKET, SNIFF, RIPTIDE, RAID_WIN, TARGET_BLOCK, BELL_RING, CROSSBOW_SHOT, FIREWORK, GLIDE, SWIM,
  CLIMB, SLEEP, CHOP_TREE, **MANUAL** (command-only), **PLACEHOLDER** (PAPI-based)
- **Progression Tracking** - Counter-based progress saved across sessions; cumulative distance (glide/swim/climb/travel)
- **8 Reward Types** - Console commands, Vault money, items (with enchants/name/lore/CMD), LuckPerms permissions,
  PlayerPoints, weighted random reward pools, global broadcast, Discord webhooks
- **Discord Webhook Integration** - Send customizable embeds on advancement completion, per-advancement toggle, custom
  embed with `%player%` and `%advancement%` placeholders
- **Notifications** - Toast popups, chat announcements, action bar progress
- **Dependencies** - Chain advancements with prerequisites for progression systems
- **Filters** - Block/item/entity type filters, world restrictions, permission gates, Custom Model Data (
  ItemsAdder/Oraxen), enchantment type/level, potion effect/amplifier, death cause, villager profession, bed color,
  sheep color, dimension, travel mode
- **Hidden Advancements** - Invisible until all prerequisites are met
- **Visual Tree** - Customizable x/y positions and connection targets for a clean advancement display
- **Database** - SQLite (file-based, easy) or MySQL/MariaDB with HikariCP connection pool
- **Multi-Language** - Built-in English and French; custom language file support
- **PlaceholderAPI** - 14+ placeholders for scores, progress, ranking, and per-tab stats
- **Auto-Migration** - Seamless upgrade from v1.70 with automatic backup
- **bStats** - Anonymous usage statistics (toggleable)

---

## Quick Start

1. Install [UltimateAdvancementAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/95585/) v2.7.1+
2. Drop the plugin in `plugins/` and restart
3. Run `/padv gui` to create advancements OR `/padv editor` for the web editor
4. Press **L** in-game to view them

## Commands

| Command                                  | Description                                       |
|------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|
| `/padv help`                             | Show help menu                                    |
| `/padv gui`                              | Open advancement management GUI (or tab selector) |
| `/padv tabs`                             | List all advancement tabs                         |
| `/padv wiki`                             | Open the plugin wiki                              |
| `/padv editor`                           | Get the web editor link                           |
| `/padv editor-trust <code>`              | Authorize a browser session                       |
| `/padv info <id>`                        | Show full advancement details                     |
| `/padv give <player> <advancement>`      | Grant an advancement to a player                  |
| `/padv take <player> <advancement\|all>` | Revoke an advancement (or all) from a player      |
| `/padv list [player]`                    | List completed advancements                       |
| `/padv stats [player]`                   | Open stats GUI with progress bars                 |
| `/padv reload`                           | Reload configuration                              |
| `/padv placeholders`                     | List all placeholders                             |

### Permissions

| Permission                         | Default  | Description                       |
|------------------------------------|----------|-----------------------------------|
| `premiumadvancements.admin`        | OP       | Full access to all admin commands |
| `premiumadvancements.give`         | OP       | Grant advancements                |
| `premiumadvancements.take`         | OP       | Revoke advancements               |
| `premiumadvancements.list`         | **true** | List own advancements             |
| `premiumadvancements.list.others`  | OP       | List others' advancements         |
| `premiumadvancements.stats`        | **true** | View own stats                    |
| `premiumadvancements.stats.others` | OP       | View others' stats                |

### Placeholders

| Placeholder                                | Description                   |
|--------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| `%premiumadvancements_completed%`          | Total completed advancements  |
| `%premiumadvancements_total%`              | Total available advancements  |
| `%premiumadvancements_progress_<id>%`      | Progress (e.g., 45/100)       |
| `%premiumadvancements_completed_<id>%`     | Completed status (true/false) |
| `%premiumadvancements_percent%`            | Overall completion %          |
| `%premiumadvancements_percent_<id>%`       | Per-advancement completion %  |
| `%premiumadvancements_latest%`             | Latest completed title        |
| `%premiumadvancements_ranking%`            | Player rank by completions    |
| `%premiumadvancements_tab_completed_<ns>%` | Tab completions               |
| `%premiumadvancements_tab_total_<ns>%`     | Tab total                     |
| `%premiumadvancements_tab_percent_<ns>%`   | Tab completion %              |

---

## Requirements

- **Paper** 1.21.4+ (or fork)
- **Java** 21+
- **UltimateAdvancementAPI** 2.7.1+ (required)
- **Vault** (optional, for money rewards)
- **PlaceholderAPI** (optional, for placeholders)
- **LuckPerms** (optional, for permission rewards)
- **PlayerPoints** (optional, for points rewards)
